text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm grabbing lunch with
Tokai Teio...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I knew there had to be some
secret.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You gotta be gettin' close to your limit!
That's
thirty bowls already!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, you might not have one, but your
stomach
does!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's just like Prez said: "Oguri possesses
boundless
power."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Boundless power... Boundless means
without limit.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, in other words, if I keep eating past
my limit,
I'll also obtain boundless
power!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Then what did she mean?
choice_data_list: そういうことじゃない気が……

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what more is there to watch? I
mean...
choice_data_list: もっと観察してみたら？

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! She just stood up and... went to get
a salad!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's it! A balanced and healthy diet is
the real
secret to gaining power! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like that wasn't quite what Symboli
Rudolf
had in mind either, but... I think
we can leave it at
that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm gonna have thirty bowls... No,
I need to
surpass Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It goes without saying, but Tokai Teio's
stomach
truly reaches its limit.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... I'll get it next time...
